name: Tuya TYWRA-RF 1ch relay 433 MHz (CB3S)
notes: 433 MHz receiver data on P26, decoded by rc-switch (in the beken-matter image). P6 is the 'total' (all on / off) button of the stock firmware. Verified on real hardware.

name: Tuya 4-gang switch module (CBU)
notes: Relay 1 is on RX1 (P10) and the LED on TX1 (P11), so UART0 is turned off (uartTx0 / uartRx0 153 = no pin) and there is no serial terminal. Wall switches on P6..P9 toggle their relay on every change of position, P23 is the on-board button. Pins from the stock Tuya config. Verified on real hardware.

name: Sparkleiot MINI 通断器 V1.3 (XH-CB2S, BK7231M)
notes: BK7231M: flash not encrypted (zero key) and the 4 MiB bootloader layout, the beken-matter image detects it (first flash: espurna-beken-initial-quectel.uf2). S1 is tied to N (non-isolated): flash it only without mains. K1 = P7 controls the relay, S1/S2 terminals = P26 toggle the dummy relay (relay 1, counted from 0), a second wall switch on the P21 test pad (not a module pin, through 1-4.7 kOhm to S1) toggles the relay. Verified on real hardware.

name: In-wall relay 86-TDQ (CB2S-type module in a slot)
notes: 1 channel, 16 A relay with a 5 V coil, button, Wi-Fi LED, wall switch input S1/S2. Pins from the stock config. The button is on P10 (RX1): the serial port leaves it to the button and keeps TX for the log. Flash from 5 V on C3. Verified on real hardware.

name: MOES MS-104B Matter (CBU, larger board than the ESP8266 MS-104B)
notes: 2 relays, S1/S2 wall-switch inputs (230 V, P14/P16, not tested), button on the board on P10 (toggles relay 1), LED. Stock Tuya Matter firmware: ESPurna keeps its factory Matter identity (MOES 0x147D / 0x084E, DAC) from the Tuya key-value store at 0x1F5000, its RF calibration from 0x1E3000, and shows the relays as On/Off Light like its certification declaration. Its Tuya bootloader 3.00 does not take our updates: replace it with the standard Tuya one over UART (ref. beken/moes-ms-104b-matter.md). Verified on real hardware (Matter in the speaker hub; relays desoldered, not switched).
